one_liner: Ecwid provides an e-commerce platform API to manage store products, orders, customers, and categories.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 is used for public apps, and static secret/public access tokens are available for custom apps.
access_notes: Sign up for a free Ecwid account and create a custom app to obtain access tokens or use OAuth.
api_notes: Covers store profile, orders, products, categories, customers, discounts, domains, dictionaries, and staff accounts via base URL https://app.ecwid.com/api/v3/{storeId}.
blocker_notes: Public REST API with self-serve credentials is fully available.

auth.quote: We use OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single-store customizations, JSON-formatted data, and a clear structure.

access.quote: There is no test mode in Ecwid API, so we recommend setting up a separate test store. This way you can safely experiment and develop without impacting your live store

verdict.quote: After signing up with Ecwid and getting a custom app, you already have two tokens

reasons.auth: Ecwid’s REST API uses OAuth 2.0 for authorization (see "We use OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single‑store customizations" in the API reference).
reasons.access: The API is available to developers who sign up and obtain credentials via the public documentation; no paid plan or trial is required for initial access.
reasons.mcp: No MCP server is documented or published by Ecwid; the API is accessed directly via the public endpoints.
reasons.verdict: Public REST API documentation is available and developers can obtain OAuth 2.0 credentials through self‑serve sign‑up, enabling immediate integration.
